map.对比狗狗与猫咪的基础代谢公式差异（犬 70×体重^0.75、猫 40×体重+20: Compare the basal metabolism formulas for dogs and cats (dogs 70 × body weight^0.75, cats 40 × body weight + 20) and control portions separately.
map.按活动量与绝育状态调整 DER 系数，已绝育/低活动宠物代谢更低，零食额度应同步: Adjust the DER factor by activity level and neuter status; neutered or low-activity pets have lower metabolism, so their treat allowance should be tightened accordingly.
map.10kg 犬 · 15kcal/颗 · 每日 5 颗 · 正常活动 · 未绝育: 10 kg dog · 15 kcal per treat · 5 treats a day · normal activity · intact
map.静息能量 RER = 70 × 10^0.75 ≈ 393.6 kcal；每日需: Resting energy RER = 70 × 10^0.75 ≈ 393.6 kcal; daily requirement DER = 393.6 × 1.6 (normal · intact) = 629.8 kcal. Total treat calories = 15 × 5 = 75 kcal, which is 11.9% of the daily total and already over the 10% safety cap (≈63 kcal). Reduce to at most 4 treats a day, or switch to small 2–5 kcal training treats. For comparison, a 4 kg cat with 5 kcal per treat × 3 treats accounts for only 6.94%, still within the safe range.
map.为什么狗狗和猫咪的算法不一样？: Why do dogs and cats use different formulas?
map.犬用 Kleiber 幂律 RER=70×体重^0.75（更适合跨体型缩放），猫: Dogs use the Kleiber power law RER = 70 × body weight^0.75 (better for scaling across body sizes), while cats use the linear RER = 40 × body weight + 20 (an empirical formula for small felids); both then multiply by activity, neuter and age factors to get DER. Mixing the formulas systematically overestimates or underestimates calories.
map.零食超标了一定要减颗数吗？: Do you always have to cut the number of treats when over the limit?
map.优先减颗数或换低热量零食；若已超标较多（>20%），还应相应扣减主粮份量（本例需: Prefer cutting the number of treats or switching to lower-calorie treats; if the excess is large (>20%), also reduce the main meal portion accordingly (in this example about 12 kcal should come out of the main food). The general veterinary rule is that treat calories should not exceed 10% of total daily calories.
map.请输入有效数值：体重与单颗热量须为正数，颗数须为非负整数。: Enter valid values: body weight and calories per treat must be positive, and the treat count must be a non-negative integer.
map.静息能量 RER：犬 = 70 × 体重^0.75；猫 = 40 × 体重 +: Resting energy RER: dog = 70 × weight^0.75; cat = 40 × weight + 20
map.日需能量 DER = RER × 活动系数: Daily energy requirement DER = RER × activity factor
Dog activity factors: low activity neutered 1.2 / intact 1.4; high activity 1.6 / 1.8; moderate 1.4 / 1.6
map.零食总热量 = 单颗热量 × 颗数: Total treat calories = calories per treat × number of treats
map.零食占比 = 零食总热量 ÷ DER × 100%: Treat share = total treat calories ÷ DER × 100%
map.零食上限 = DER × 10%；每日最多颗数 = ⌊上限 ÷ 单颗热量⌋: Treat limit = DER × 10%; maximum treats per day = ⌊limit ÷ calories per treat⌋
map.判定：占比 ≤10% 安全｜≤20% 偏高｜其他 超标: Assessment: share ≤10% safe | ≤20% high | otherwise excessive
map.超标时须减少颗数并同步扣减主粮份量: When excessive, reduce the number of treats and deduct the same calories from the main meal
map.条形图对比当前占比与 10% 建议上限: Bar chart comparing the current share with the 10% recommended limit
map.零食也计入每日总能量；填主粮实际量后，会按总摄入与目标差额给出主粮调整量。: Treats count toward daily energy; with actual staple intake, staple adjustment is based on total intake vs target.
map.训练期高频给零食时，用 RER/DER 粗算热量参考，并填入兽医目标与实际主粮量: During frequent treat training, rough-estimate energy with RER/DER, enter vet target and actual staple intake, and adjust by total daily intake.
map.对比犬猫基础代谢公式差异，分别核算；所有结果都是估算，不是个体营养处方。: Compare dog and cat resting-energy formulas and calculate separately; all results are estimates, not individual nutrition prescriptions.
map.老年、幼龄、疾病或体重管理场景应使用兽医给出的目标，不直接套用模型系数。: For senior, young, ill or weight-management cases, use a vet-provided target instead of model factors.
map.10kg 犬、15 kcal/颗 × 5 颗、正常活动、未绝育：RER ≈ 39: A 10 kg dog, 15 kcal/treat × 5, normal activity, intact: RER ≈ 393.6 kcal, DER ≈ 629.8 kcal (rough). Treats 75 kcal = 11.9%, above the 10% reference; with a 600 kcal vet target it is 12.5%. If actual staple is 600 kcal, total is 675 kcal—75 kcal over target—so reduce staple by ~75 kcal even if treat share looks close. Consult a vet for young, ill or weight-management cases.
map.先看全天总摄入：主粮实际量 + 零食热量 与目标比较，超出多少就优先扣减主粮多少: Check total intake first: actual staple + treats vs target; reduce staple by any excess. A treat share ≤10% only means “not a large share”, not unlimited allowance. Vet target overrides the model.
